## #1 — Krassimir — 2012-02-01

Can't Access Scripts!

Hi, I've been using Cheetah 3d, ver 5.8, for about two weeks and today I encountered a problem when I made my first attempt to run a script. I went Tools -> Script only to discover that the subfolders particle script, polygon script, spline script etc... behave as if they are empty. I checked the actual script folder in the cheetah folder and the scripts are present, yet I can't seem to find a way to use them. Has anyone experienced this? 

Thanks!

## #2 — frank beckmann — 2012-02-01
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8082/post-67153>

Hi and welcome.
Scripts go

[[QUOTE:  • Scripts can now only be installed in the "~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts" folder Click to expand... ]]

When you´re using Lion you have to make the "Library" folder visible first.

Cheers
Frank

## #4 — podperson — 2012-02-06
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8082/post-67288>

You can also select "Go to folder" in Finder and paste in "~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/" and it "just works" (even though it's a subfolder of an invisible folder). You can then make an alias of the scripts folder and put it somewhere convenient (e.g. next to Cheetah 3D in your Applications folder).
